predictions.articleTitle: Santos vs Palmeiras Prediction & Match Analysis: Peixe Adapt to Neymar Absence — Scoreline & xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Palmeiras to exploit Neymar's absence and maintain their title charge in a tight, low-scoring derby at Vila Belmiro.
possibilityAssessment: Palmeiras asserts midfield control through Andreas Pereira and grinds out a disciplined 0:1 road win (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Santos relies on defensive compactness and Gabriel Barbosa to secure a hard-fought 1:1 draw (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
An intense, foul-heavy midfield battle results in a goalless 0:0 stalemate (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Neymar suspended as title-chasing Palmeiras visit Vila Belmiro

spf.comment: Covers Palmeiras' superior defensive framework alongside Vila Belmiro's resilient home draw history.

over_under.comment: Palmeiras has conceded only 22 league goals while Santos lacks creative punch without Neymar.

score.comment: Reflects the primary 0:1 away win script and the secondary 1:1 derby stalemate.

goals.comment: Two goals represents the modal outcome, with a one-goal defensive grind as the secondary branch.

bqc.comment: Expect a cautious opening half before Palmeiras' quality or fatigue forces a second-half breakthrough.
